featured_reviews.name: Geeta Chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased a kids electric bike from Mohain Shaikh (Zizi Toys), Kurla West on 15-10-2025 for ₹9,500. At the time of purchase itself, the bike already had issues — the mirror was faulty and one part was missing/broken. I informed them immediately, but since it was my child’s birthday, they requested me to take the bike and promised service the next day at my house.

After repeatedly following up, their person came sometime in mid-November 2025 (exact date not remembered). Even then, the service was completely unprofessional. The mirror was fitted again on the same faulty plastic area, where the screw does not even fit properly. It was only a temporary adjustment, not a real solution. On top of that, the missing part was never brought.

I complained again, but all I got were excuses like “I will send the bike to my shop”, “I am in my village”, “I am busy”, etc. I kept trusting them because at the time of purchase they clearly said lifetime free service (only parts chargeable).

Today it is 02-02-2026, and there has been no call, no message, no follow-up from their side. This has been a very bad and disappointing experience. Zero responsibility, zero professionalism, and false commitments.

I strongly feel people should think twice before buying anything from here. Toys and products may look attractive, but service and after-sales support are absolutely useless. I would not recommend Zizi Toys to anyone.
Zero star from my side
